answer: Each account may delegate votes, but rewards are paid only after a randomly selected task is completed and verified by agents with independent stake; duplicate submissions from linked accounts count as one. A timber supplier, for example, cannot multiply its influence by inventing identities: each new account must fund a separate stake and still pass the same checks. Sybils therefore dilute the attacker’s own capital, while a crystal buyer or bridge builder can rely on verified work rather than account counts.
